en.explanation:
All four complexes contain (, low spin), and the energy of the light absorbed rises with the crystal field splitting ; since , a larger means a shorter wavelength absorbed.

follows the spectrochemical series . Replacing one of by lowers , and replacing it by lowers it further, so is in the order C > B > A > D.

The wavelength of light absorbed is in the reverse order: D > A > B > C.

Hence, the correct option is (C).

en.content:
Which of the following statements are correct?

A. The process of adding an electron to a neutral gaseous atom is always exothermic.

B. The process of removing an electron from an isolated gaseous atom is always endothermic.

C. The ionization energy of boron is less than that of beryllium.

D. The electronegativity of C is 2.5 in and

E. Li is the most electropositive among elements of group I.

Choose the correct answer from the options given below:

options.content: A, C and D Only
B and C Only
B and D Only
B, C and E Only

en.explanation:
A: Adding an electron to a neutral gaseous atom is not always exothermic; for noble gases, and for atoms such as Be and N, the electron gain enthalpy is positive. A is incorrect.

B: Removing an electron from an isolated gaseous atom always needs energy to overcome the attraction of the nucleus, so ionisation enthalpy is always positive. B is correct.

C: Be () loses an electron from the filled, more penetrating orbital, while B () loses its single electron, which is shielded by the electrons; hence of B () is less than that of Be (). C is correct.

D: The electronegativity of an element is not constant; it depends on the atoms bonded to it. In the four more electronegative Cl atoms leave carbon with a partial positive charge, raising its effective nuclear charge and electronegativity above that in . D is incorrect.

E: Electropositive character increases down group 1, so Li is the least electropositive alkali metal and Cs the most. E is incorrect.

The correct statements are B and C.

Hence, the correct option is (B).

D : किसी तत्व की विद्युत ऋणात्मकता स्थिर नहीं होती; यह उससे आबद्ध परमाणुओं पर निर्भर करती है। में चार अधिक विद्युत ऋणात्मक Cl परमाणु कार्बन पर आंशिक धनावेश छोड़ देते हैं, जिससे उसका प्रभावी नाभिकीय आवेश बढ़ता है और उसकी विद्युत ऋणात्मकता की तुलना में अधिक हो जाती है। D गलत है।

E : समूह 1 में ऊपर से नीचे जाने पर धनविद्युती गुण बढ़ता है, अतः Li क्षार धातुओं में सबसे कम धनविद्युती तथा Cs सर्वाधिक धनविद्युती है। E गलत है।

en.content: Which of the following postulate of Bohr's model of hydrogen atom is not in agreement with quantum mechanical model of an atom?

options.content: The electron in a H atom's stationary state moves in a circle around the nucleus.

An atom can take only certain distinct energies <mjx-container class="MathJax" jax="SVG" overflow="overflow"><svg style="vertical-align: -0.439ex;" width="9.597ex" height="1.977ex" role="img" viewBox="0 -680 4242 874"><g stroke="currentColor" fill="currentColor" stroke-width="0" transform="scale(1,-1)"><g><g><g data-mjx-texclass="ORD"><g><use href="#MJX-TEX-N-45"/></g></g><g transform="translate(714,-150) scale(0.707)"><use href="#MJX-TEX-N-31"/></g></g><g transform="translate(1117.6,0)"><use href="#MJX-TEX-N-2C"/></g><g transform="translate(1562.2,0)"><g data-mjx-texclass="ORD"><g><use href="#MJX-TEX-N-45"/></g></g><g transform="translate(714,-150) scale(0.707)"><use href="#MJX-TEX-N-32"/></g></g><g transform="translate(2679.8,0)"><use href="#MJX-TEX-N-2C"/></g><g transform="translate(3124.4,0)"><g data-mjx-texclass="ORD"><g><use href="#MJX-TEX-N-45"/></g></g><g transform="translate(714,-150) scale(0.707)"><use href="#MJX-TEX-N-33"/></g></g></g></g></svg></mjx-container>, etc. These allowed states of constant energy are called the stationary states of atom.
An atom in a stationary state does not emit electromagnetic radiation as long as it stays in the same state.
When an electron makes a transition from a higher energy stationary state to a lower energy stationary state, then it emits a photon of light.

en.explanation:
The postulate that contradicts quantum mechanics is

Option A

“The electron in a H atom’s stationary state moves in a circle around the nucleus.”

In quantum mechanics an electron in a stationary state is described by a delocalized wave‐function (an orbital), not by a definite circular orbit.

en.content: Which compound would give 3-methyl-6-oxoheptanal upon ozonolysis?
en.explanation:
3-Methyl-6-oxoheptanal ("oxo" is the IUPAC prefix for a ketone ) is .

Ozonolysis of a cycloalkene cleaves the ring into a single open chain carrying both carbonyl groups, so the aldehyde carbon (C-1) and the keto carbon (C-6) were the two ends of the ring double bond.

Joining C-1 and C-6 by a double bond gives a six-membered ring with a methyl group on C-6 (from C-7) and another on C-3. C-3 and C-6 are separated by two ring carbons on each side, so the alkene is 1,4-dimethylcyclohex-1-ene, structure (A).

Ozonolysis (, then ) of 1,4-dimethylcyclohex-1-ene therefore gives .

Structures (B), (C) and (D) place the second methyl elsewhere and give 5-methyl-, 2-methyl- and 4-methyl-6-oxoheptanal respectively.

Hence, the correct option is (A).

चक्रीय ऐल्कीन के ओजोनी अपघटन में वलय का विदलित होकर एक खुली शृंखला बनाता है जिसमें दोनों कार्बोनिल समूह होते हैं; अतः ऐल्डिहाइड कार्बन (C-1) और कीटो कार्बन (C-6) वलय के द्विबंध के दोनों सिरे थे।

C-1 और C-6 को द्विबंध से जोड़ने पर छह-सदस्यीय वलय बनता है जिसमें C-6 (C-7 से) पर एक मेथिल समूह तथा C-3 पर दूसरा मेथिल समूह है। C-3 और C-6 के बीच प्रत्येक ओर दो वलय कार्बन हैं, अतः ऐल्कीन 1,4-डाइमेथिलसाइक्लोहेक्स-1-ईन है, संरचना (A)।

अतः 1,4-डाइमेथिलसाइक्लोहेक्स-1-ईन का ओजोनी अपघटन (, फिर ) देता है।

अतः, सही विकल्प (A) है।

en.content: Which of the following properties will change when system containing solution 1 will become solution 2 ?

options.content: Molar heat capacity
Concentration
Gibbs free energy
Density

en.explanation:
Solution 1 contains 10 mol of x in 10 L of water, that is, 1 mol of x per litre of water.

Solution 2 is made from 1 L of solution 1 together with 1 mol of x and 1 L of water; the added solute and water are again in the ratio 1 mol per litre, so solution 2 has the same composition as solution 1 but a much smaller total amount.

Molar heat capacity, concentration and density are intensive properties: at the same temperature and pressure they depend only on composition, so they do not change.

Gibbs free energy is an extensive property: it is proportional to the amount of the system, so it changes from solution 1 to solution 2.

Hence, the correct option is (C).

en.content:
Given below are two statements :

Statement I : A catalyst cannot alter the equilibrium constant of the reaction, temperature remaining constant.

Statement II : A homogeneous catalyst can change the equilibrium composition of a system, temperature remaining constant.

In the light of the above statements, choose the correct answer from the options given below

options.content: Statement I is true but Statement II is false
Statement I is false but Statement II is true
Both Statement I and Statement II are true
Both Statement I and Statement II are false

en.explanation:
Let's analyze both statements:

Statement I: "A catalyst cannot alter the equilibrium constant () of the reaction, temperature remaining constant."

A catalyst speeds up both the forward and reverse reactions equally, allowing the system to reach equilibrium faster.

However, it does not change the energy difference between reactants and products (i.e., the Gibbs free energy change), which directly determines the equilibrium constant.

Therefore, this statement is true.

Statement II: "A homogeneous catalyst can change the equilibrium composition of a system, temperature remaining constant."

A homogeneous catalyst acts in the same phase as the reactants and, like any catalyst, it only helps the reaction reach equilibrium more quickly.

It does not alter the equilibrium position, meaning the relative concentrations of reactants and products at equilibrium remain unchanged if the temperature is constant.

Thus, this statement is false.

In summary:

Statement I is true.

Statement II is false.

The correct answer is: Option A.

कथन I: "एक उत्प्रेरक अभिक्रिया के साम्यावस्था स्थिरांक () को परिवर्तित नहीं कर सकता, तापमान स्थिर रहने पर।"

एक उत्प्रेरक अग्र और विपरीत दोनों अभिक्रियाओं को समान रूप से तीव्र करता है, जिससे निकाय शीघ्र साम्यावस्था पर पहुँच जाता है।

हालांकि, यह अभिकारकों और उत्पादों के बीच ऊर्जा अंतर (अर्थात्, गिब्स मुक्त ऊर्जा परिवर्तन) को नहीं बदलता है, जो सीधे साम्यावस्था स्थिरांक को निर्धारित करता है।

अतः, यह कथन सत्य है।

कथन II: "एक समांगी उत्प्रेरक निकाय के साम्य संघटन को परिवर्तित कर सकता है, तापमान स्थिर रहने पर।"

एक समांगी उत्प्रेरक अभिकारकों के समान प्रावस्था में कार्य करता है और किसी भी उत्प्रेरक की तरह, यह केवल अभिक्रिया को साम्यावस्था तक अधिक शीघ्रता से पहुँचने में सहायता करता है।

यह साम्यावस्था स्थिति को परिवर्तित नहीं करता है, अर्थात् साम्यावस्था पर अभिकारकों और उत्पादों की सापेक्ष सांद्रता अपरिवर्तित रहती है यदि तापमान स्थिर है।

अतः, यह कथन असत्य है।

सारांश में:

कथन I सत्य है।

कथन II असत्य है।

सही उत्तर है: विकल्प A।

आयडोफॉर्म अभिक्रिया न देने वाले यौगिकों की संख्या ।

अतः, सही विकल्प (A) है।

Water at 273 K is denser than ice, so the volume of the ice-water system decreases as the slab melts () while the pressure stays at the atmospheric value .

Match the LIST-I with LIST-II

List - I
 List - II
A. I. Chemical reaction
B. II. Fusion with +ve Q value
C. III. Fission
D. IV. Fusion with -ve Q value

Choose the correct answer from the options given below:

options.content: A-II, B-I, C-III, D-IV
A-III, B-I, C-II, D-IV
A-III, B-I, C-IV, D-II
A-II, B-I, C-IV, D-III

en.explanation:
Here’s the correct matching:

A.

–– This is nuclear fission ⇒ III.

B.

–– This is a chemical reaction ⇒ I.

C.

–– This D–D fusion releases about 3.3 MeV ⇒ fusion with +ve Q ⇒ II.

D.

–– The mass of products exceeds reactants ⇒ requires energy ⇒ fusion with –ve Q ⇒ IV.

So the answer is

Option B: A–III, B–I, C–II, D–IV.

B. II. धनात्मक Q मान के साथ संलयन
C. III. विखण्डन
D. IV. ऋणात्मक Q मान के साथ संलयन

नीचे दिए गए विकल्पों में से सही उत्तर चुनें:

options.content: A-II, B-I, C-III, D-IV
A-III, B-I, C-II, D-IV
A-III, B-I, C-IV, D-II
A-II, B-I, C-IV, D-III

hi.explanation:
यहाँ सही मिलान दिया गया है:

A.

–– यह नाभिकीय विखंडन है ⇒ III.

B.

–– यह एक रासायनिक अभिक्रिया है ⇒ I.

C.

–– यह D–D संलयन लगभग 3.3 MeV ऊर्जा मुक्त करता है ⇒ धनात्मक Q के साथ संलयन ⇒ II.

D.

–– उत्पादों का द्रव्यमान अभिकारकों से अधिक है ⇒ ऊर्जा की आवश्यकता होती है ⇒ ऋणात्मक Q के साथ संलयन ⇒ IV.

अतः उत्तर है

विकल्प B: A–III, B–I, C–II, D–IV.
